description: This file declares functions and structures for managing nl80211 wireless interface events, information, and commands related to access points, including event listeners, interface info retrieval, station info, vendor commands, management frames, frame registration, and MLD interface discovery.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_setEvtListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for all received nl80211 events from an AP interface, with specified handlers and user data.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delEvtListener
methods.description: Deletes the event listener for an AP interface's nl80211 events.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a single AP or AP MLD interface, including physical and logical info.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delVapInterface
methods.description: Deletes an AP interface; if it matches the main radio interface, sets it as a station interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info and statistics of a station device.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getAllStationsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info and statistics of all paired station devices.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_copyStationInfoToAssocDev
methods.description: Copies station info to an associated device struct, checking capabilities and radio info.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmd
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific subcommand to the driver.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmdAttr
methods.description: Sends a vendor subcommand with attributes inside vendor data.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_registerFrame
methods.description: Registers to receive specific frame types.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_findMldIfaceInfo
methods.description: Finds relative AP MLD interface including MLO link matching AP MAC address.
